About today's snapshot
- **Recovery** — your device's daily readiness signal: **Readiness Score** (Oura, 0–100) or **Body Battery** (Garmin, 0–100). Whichever vendor you have fills this tile.
- **Sleep Score / Activity Score** — Oura's 0–100 ratings of last night's sleep and yesterday's activity balance.
- **HRV Balance** — Oura's 0–100 readiness sub-score from your overnight heart-rate variability (not raw HRV in ms — that's on Wellness → Vitals).
- **Resting Heart Rate / Blood Oxygen (SpO₂)** — overnight resting HR and blood-oxygen saturation (95–100% typical).
- **Total Sleep / Steps / Active Calories** — last night's sleep duration and today-so-far movement.
- **Skin Temp Deviation** — how far last night's body temperature ran from your baseline (± °C); Oura-specific.
- Tiles read your **most recent** value per metric; each shows a titled placeholder when the source device has no data.

**Learn more:** [Oura — Readiness](https://support.ouraring.com/hc/en-us/articles/360025587493-Readiness-Score) · [Garmin — Body Battery](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/garmin-technology/health-science/body-battery/)"}},"sleep_cap":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_sleep_detail"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary | seriesByName('src_lbl') | lastPoint()","majorFontSize":13,"majorColor":"#8a93a0","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","showLabel":false,"trendDisplay":"off","sparklineDisplay":"off","align":"left"},"hideWhenNoData":true},"steps_cap":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_activity"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary | seriesByName('steps_lbl') | lastPoint()","majorFontSize":13,"majorColor":"#8a93a0","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","showLabel":false,"trendDisplay":"off","sparklineDisplay":"off","align":"left"},"hideWhenNoData":true},"cal_cap":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_activity"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary | seriesByName('acal_lbl') | lastPoint()","majorFontSize":13,"majorColor":"#8a93a0","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","showLabel":false,"trendDisplay":"off","sparklineDisplay":"off","align":"left"},"hideWhenNoData":true},"rhr_cap":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_resting_hr"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary | seriesByName('rhr_src') | lastPoint()","majorFontSize":13,"majorColor":"#8a93a0","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","showLabel":false,"trendDisplay":"off","sparklineDisplay":"off","align":"left"},"hideWhenNoData":true},"spo2_cap":{"type":"splunk.singlevalue","dataSources":{"primary":"ds_spo2"},"options":{"majorValue":"> primary | seriesByName('src_lbl') | lastPoint()","majorFontSize":13,"majorColor":"#8a93a0","backgroundColor":"rgba(15,17,23,0.50)","showLabel":false,"trendDisplay":"off","sparklineDisplay":"off","align":"left"},"hideWhenNoData":true},"lastsync_tbl":{"type":"splunk.table","title":"Your data sources -
